name: Like prompt
summary: Outline heart that gets tapped, fills red, bursts small hearts and ticks its count up; for like calls to action.

params.name: likes
params.note: count shown before the tap; ticks up by one on the tap

params.name: clickAt
params.note: frame of the tap, after at

params.name: color
params.note: heart colour when filled; default red

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
